**Official municipal websites of the five most‑populous cities (2023‑2024 estimates)**  

| Rank | City (Country) | Approx. population (city proper) | Official municipal website* |

| 3 | **Shanghai, China** | ~ 24 million (city) – ~ 27 million metro area | <http://english.shanghai.gov.cn/> (English portal) |
| 4 | **São Paulo, Brazil** | ~ 12 million (city) – ~ 22 million metro area | <https://www.capital.sp.gov.br/> |
| 5 | **Mexico City, Mexico** | ~ 9 million (city) – ~ 22 million metro area | <https://www.cdmx.gob.mx/> |

\*These URLs are the primary official portals for each city’s municipal government (or, where available, the English‑language version of that portal). They are maintained by the respective city/metro authorities and provide information on services, regulations, news, and contact details.
